messages:
Maria K.: main is red on the integration matrix, only one axis failing repeatedly: integration-linux-3. failing with `timeout waiting for service` two runs in a row. anyone seen this?

TJ: saw a couple flakes there yesterday. you can resubmit just that worker instead of full rebuild. quick command:```/ci retry --job=integration-linux --shard=3 --no-image-build```

Maria K.: nice — does --no-image-build skip the whole image step? want to avoid the 10m image build if possible.

Samir P.: yep, --no-image-build will skip rebuilding container images and just requeue the job. if you need to avoid touching cache keys, use `--preserve-cache` too.

Olivia: also if it's a flaky test, try a lightweight rerun first (`/ci retry --job=integration-linux --shard=3`) without other flags, then escalate to no-image if the first rerun is green. saves infra quota. :thumbsup:

Maria K.: trying lightweight rerun now... `/ci retry --job=integration-linux --shard=3`

ci-bot: Received retry request for job=integration-linux shard=3. queued on runner pool "linux-integration-2".

ci-bot: Run succeeded on retry (exit 0). Tests passed. :tada:

Maria K.: ok green this time. thanks!

Olivia: if it keeps flaking, we can bisect the changeset range with `/ci bisect --job=integration-linux --start=origin/main~50 --end=origin/main` — only use when you suspect a regression.

Samir P.: FYI, if you ever need to rerun the whole matrix but still skip heavy steps (image build / e2e infra provisioning), we use:```/ci retry --job=integration-linux --all-shards --no-image-build --no-provision```

Maria K.: adding a short note to the PR describing the flaky axis so reviewers know it's transient. thanks for the commands.

ops-bot: Docs: https://internal.devops.redwood/ci/retries — covers `--no-image-build`, `--preserve-cache`, and shard selection.

TJ: sweet. marking this one resolved. :white_check_mark:

Maria K.: closing the loop here — will follow up if it reappears.
